scope: Structural optimization of the compiler physics backend; independent judge and compiler search unchanged.

retained: same source/cwd with only compiler WASM changed
paired percentage-delta bootstrap and median safeguard
repairs: private snapshot instead of swapping the live package
xorshift32 RNG avoids floating-point LCG multiplication and endpoint indexing

limitations: Bootstrap support is not a posterior probability or an anytime-valid stopping rule.
Fresh confirmation reduces selection bias; these runs do not establish effects across unseen songs or different machines.
Sign-test interpretation assumes independent pairs and exchangeable signs under the null.
The A/A run is a finite host sanity check, not complete calibration; it covers engine mode, not compiler mode.
Dependencies are shared from the installation; package-lock is fingerprinted. They were not changed between arms or stages.
